Fetch an Ontario SIU director's report by drid

Source: R/fetch_siu.R
siufetch.Rd

Downloads the web page of one director's report of the Ontario Special Investigations Unit (SIU), the agency that investigates police interactions that end in death, serious injury or sexual-assault allegations, and saves its HTML to dest. Reports are identified by their drid number. If the live site does not answer, a copy from the Wayback Machine is used. This is the fetch step of the open SIU corpus pipeline: pair it with the SIU parser in this package (siufprs fetches and parses in one call; the compiled core under src/siu_*.cpp is the canonical implementation, and rmorie links to the same core) to rebuild the director's-report corpus yourself.

Usage

siufetch(drid, dest, lang = c("en", "fr"), wb = "", tmout = 120L)

Arguments

drid

Director's-report id: the drid= query parameter, one positive whole number (integer or integer-like, such as 648 or "648").

dest

Character string: the file to write the fetched HTML to.

lang

"en" (default) or "fr": the language of the report page.

wb

Optional explicit Wayback snapshot URL (passed through to blfetch); "" (the default) lets it discover one.

tmout

Request timeout in seconds. Default 120.

Value

"live" or "wayback" (invisibly), as blfetch: which source the HTML came from.

Details

The URL fetched is
https://www.siu.on.ca/<lang>/directors_report_details.php?drid=<drid>
through blfetch, which tries the live page first and falls back to a Wayback Machine snapshot (the one given in wb, or one it looks up).

Network: one or more HTTPS requests to www.siu.on.ca and, on failure, web.archive.org. Side effect: writes dest.

Errors, before any request: drid not one positive whole number (1.5 is refused rather than read as report 1); lang not "en" or "fr"; dest not a single non-empty string. Then any error from blfetch(), for example when neither the live page nor an archived copy can be reached.

See also

blfetch, siufprs

Examples

# the report number is checked before anything is sent
try(siufetch(1.5, tempfile(fileext = ".html")))
#> Error : `drid` must be one positive report number (the drid in the SIU report URL)
try(siufetch(648, tempfile(fileext = ".html"), lang = "de"))
#> Error : siufetch: `lang` must be one of "en", "fr", not "de"

# a real fetch needs the network (the SIU site or the Wayback Machine)

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
dest <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
siufetch(648, dest)
siufetch(648, tempfile(fileext = ".html"), lang = "fr")
}
